cover.subtitle: The branch ledger for every Harrisons Sabah branch.
newItems: Export takes the whole selection by default
A selection Total above the page Sub-total
Group list starts empty; Reset returns there

features.title: Branch at a glance
features.body: The header shows the open balance, late orders and document mix for the branch you pick.

bullets.text: Pick a branch, or ALL for every branch
Open balance, open orders and orders past ship date
Document mix and the last updated time

features.title: Business units
features.body: Choose FMCG, TPD, CNF or Others. The group list and the sheet follow your choice.

bullets.text: Four units: FMCG, TPD, CNF and Others
Tick more than one unit at a time
Group lists show only the units you tick

features.title: Narrow by group
features.body: Work by item group or by sales group. Tick one, several, or all of them.

bullets.text: Switch between item groups and sales groups
Select all, or Reset to the default
Tick several groups to see them together

features.title: Filter and find
features.body: Limit the list by created date, modified date and status, or find a single order.

bullets.text: Created from and to date
Modified from and to date
Status, and Find by order, customer or account

features.title: Selection totals
features.body: The Total covers the whole selection. The Sub-total covers only the page on screen.

bullets.text: Total: every order in the selection
Sub-total: only the rows on this page
HAR_SOAmount, HAR_InvoicedAmount and HAR_SOBalance

features.title: Shape the table
features.body: Sort, filter and reorder columns. Show 50, 100, 200 or 500 rows a page.

bullets.text: Click a column title to sort
Commas match several values, such as 079222, 079S03
Drag titles to reorder. Reset columns undoes it.

features.title: Export to Excel
features.body: Download a workbook of what you are looking at, with the same columns and filters.

bullets.text: Export workbook takes the whole selection
Tick Export current page rows for this page only
Sheets: Lines, By item group, By sales group

features.title: Branch access
features.body: Super users assign roles and branches on People. Everyone signs in with a harrisons.com.my email and an 8-digit code.

bullets.text: Add someone before they sign in
Roles: super user, admin and normal user
Tick ALL for every branch, including future ones
